accepted_gaps.statement: No validated cross-species battery cleanly separates general cognitive flexibility from species-specialized expertise while accounting for sensory and motor affordances.
The extent to which performance transfers across task families is unresolved because many demonstrations are domain-specific.
The contribution of social learning and cooperation to later flexible problem solving is not quantitatively separated from individual learning history.
Cognitive performance in radically different body plans is difficult to compare without an affordance-aware measurement model.
Performance orderings may reverse across domains, but the covariance structure of those reversals is under-measured.

rejected_or_unresolved_candidates.reason: domain-specific performance reversals and task mismatch

rejected_or_unresolved_candidates.claim: Tool manufacture alone demonstrates general intelligence
rejected_or_unresolved_candidates.reason: ecological specialization and motor affordances are confounded

rejected_or_unresolved_candidates.claim: Brain size alone predicts cognitive ability
rejected_or_unresolved_candidates.reason: brain size is not a direct measure of task-specific cognition
